messages:
Alex (CS): Brookfield onboarding flagged: intermittent P95 spikes in their invoice chat flow during nightly ETL. Renewal ~60 days. Want low-risk ops recs we can run quickly.
Priya (Solutions): thanks Alex. saw the spike cluster on dashboards. model/region? sample prompt?
Alex (CS): running redwood/gpt-large in eu-west, FP16. Typical prompt: `extract PO, vendor, total from invoice` (~60 tokens). P95 baseline ~1.0s -> spikes to ~3.2s during batch window; cost up ~16%.
Mateo (SE): quick wins: enable KV-prefix caching for repeated invoice headers, small batching tweaks, and a conservative int8 canary for short requests.
CanaryBot: automated suggestion: start 10% int8 canary for requests <1200 tokens + EU->US fallback on p99>2.5s. Estimated cost -20%, P95 -25% on sampled traces.
Hana (Eng): implementation plan (short): create `redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary`, route rule: if region==eu-west AND p99_latency>2.5s -> fallback to us-west (policy: brookfield-fallback), traffic split 90/10 for tokens<1200, enable KV-prefix cache for invoice templates, tag traces `brookfield-canary-3267890123`.
Priya (Solutions): include rollback: auto-rollback if extractor accuracy drops >0.8% or errors +10% in 24h. We'll run a 250-sample QA and collect 50 random prompts for manual review. Draft customer note with expected KPIs: cost ~-20%, P95 ~-25%, 48h checkpoint.
Alex (CS): good. I'll schedule 30m kickoff with CSM + infra + Solutions tomorrow. Mateo, can you add SDK snippet for per-route override?
Mateo (SE): yes: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary","route":"brookfield-fallback","metadata":{"tag":"brookfield-canary-3267890123"}}'`
Hana (Eng): Ops will run auto-eval at 48h and post results here. If any extractor regressions, pin extractor endpoints to FP16 immediately and continue other pilots.
CanaryBot: preflight eval (180 samples): precision delta 0.4% (within tolerance), flagged 5 date-format edge cases. Recommend manual QA of flagged samples before starting.
Alex (CS): thanks team. Priya, please have the pilot draft by EOD. I'll capture customer feedback after 48h and post snapshots. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Solutions): on it — will include slide and rollback checklist.
Hana (Eng): adding trace filters and alert hooks now.
Alex (CS): perfect — posting kickoff once draft ready.
